questions.question: What is the molecular mass?

answers.a: The mass of all the molecules together

questions.question: How do you calculate the molecular mass?

answers.a: You add up the atomic masses of all the atoms in the molecule
answers.b: You measure the pressure and the temperature
answers.c: You multiply the concentrations of the substances
answers.d: You subtract the mass of the products from the mass of the reactants

questions.question: What is the mass ratio of a reaction?

answers.a: The ratio between the numbers of molecules that react
answers.b: The ratio between the mass and the volume of a substance
answers.c: The ratio between the masses of the substances that react with each other and are formed
answers.d: The ratio between the mass of a substance and the time the reaction takes

questions.question: You are going to do a calculation on a reaction. What do you do first?

answers.d: Weigh the mass of the product

questions.question: What is an excess?

answers.a: A substance that does not take part in the reaction
answers.b: A reactant that is completely used up after the reaction
answers.c: The ideal amount of a substance
answers.d: A reactant of which some is left over after the reaction

questions.question: How do you find out which reactant is in excess?

answers.b: You calculate how much of one substance you need for the other and compare that with what you have
answers.d: You measure the concentration of the substances
